## Definitions

- [statement] The Game Crafter says same-size cards within one game copy are not sorted by deck. It directs designers to embedded games for separately packaged decks and to cart quantity for separately packaged identical game copies. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-28) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/399-how-to-make-a-card-game-tarot-deck · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The MPC URL named integrate-playing-cards is a seller marketplace deck, not API documentation. Its page displays $33.85 for 1–5 copies of a 54-card M31 Linen deck with a custom T30 gloss tuck box, and also says the seller stopped selling it. This inactive listing is not a quote for the commissioned game; a USD currency selection, freight and tax total were not established. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/sell/marketplace/integrate-playing-cards.html · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment

## Structure and components

- [statement] The Game Crafter quote workflow requires the total number of cards of each type and chosen surfacing. Its downloaded estimate describes one game copy and excludes stock components and some custom-shape cutting charges; generic example prices do not establish a complete configured-game cost. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-01-22) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/23-game-costs · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment · also: https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/399-how-to-make-a-card-game-tarot-deck
- [statement] The Game Crafter’s Linen Texture page displays an add-on charge of $.25 per component sheet. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/178-linen-texture · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The Game Crafter’s UV Coating page displays an add-on charge of $.25 per component sheet. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/169-uv-coating · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] In the Fullasagoog Ziggurat playtest thread about components from Game Crafter, tabicat reported on 30 June 2026 that the linen finish was inconsistent and very shiny, making artwork almost impossible to see at some angles. On 2 July 2026, Genghis-Pawn said they might prefer the texture to smooth cards, while noting occasional smudgy patterning. These are attributed participant observations. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.fullasagoog.com/t/unboxing-first-impressions/62 · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment

## How it works

- [statement] The Game Crafter bills complete sheets even when some positions are unused; its guide illustrates poker sheets holding 18 cards. This is a sheet-utilization constraint, not a per-card price quote. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-28) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/399-how-to-make-a-card-game-tarot-deck · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] MPC MarketPlace’s FAQ states a 5% handling fee on product sales earnings and product base price. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/marketplace/faq-marketplace.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC MarketPlace’s FAQ states that receiving earnings via PayPal incurs an additional 8% processing fee. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/marketplace/faq-marketplace.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The Game Crafter’s Cards help page states a limit of 2000 total components per game. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/85-cards · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC’s Shipping page says that if unsuccessful attempts to contact or deliver to the recipient prevent delivery, MPC cannot arrange a replacement or refund and the customer must place a new order. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/shipping.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The Game Crafter’s selling guide describes producing and shipping shop purchases directly to buyers. MPC’s fulfillment page describes manufacturing playing cards and sending them directly to end clients. These are documented service descriptions, rather than commissioned-game production commitments. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/367-selling-your-game · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment · also: https://www.makeplayingcards.com/mpc-fulfillment-services.aspx
- [statement] The Game Crafter accepts individually uploaded PNG or JPG card images rather than a PDF deck; its guide requires a unique filename for each image to avoid replacing an earlier upload. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-28) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/399-how-to-make-a-card-game-tarot-deck · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The Game Crafter warns that dark edge artwork can expose white stock when toner chips during cutting, and that borders exaggerate registration drift. These are manufacturer disclosures rather than measured defect rates. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-07-28) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/32-designer-tips · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC’s general ordering FAQ says customers may order a single copy without a minimum order quantity. Its custom-game-card page separately requires 1000 decks for M30 and M32 stock. Preserve these attributed scopes rather than applying the general no-minimum statement to every stock option. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/design/custom-blank-card.html · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment · also: https://www.makeplayingcards.com/faq-order.aspx

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Game Crafter requires purchasing a physical copy before publishing and states a 10-day publishing wait. Private ordering does not require publishing in its shop. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-11) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/109-publishing-help · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The Game Crafter distinguishes production completion estimates from delivery dates and routes orders of 10 or more copies into a separate bulk queue; a short normal-queue estimate therefore does not establish a larger order delivery promise. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-01-22) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/94-production-queues · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The Game Crafter explicitly does not guarantee exact color matching across printings or materials, citing humidity, heat, fuser age and toner changes. Identical artwork therefore does not establish visually identical repeat batches. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-07-28) — https://help.thegamecrafter.com/article/32-designer-tips · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC lists individually customizable fronts and backs for its 63mm x 88mm custom game cards, with deck counts from 18 to 612. Its broad no-minimum offer has stock-specific exceptions: M30 and M32 require 1000 decks. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/design/custom-blank-card.html · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment · also: https://www.makeplayingcards.com/faq-order.aspx
- [statement] MPC fulfillment includes packing labor, packaging and labeling but adds a parcel surcharge to ordinary shipping. Its published policy makes the service user responsible for taxes and import charges; those costs must remain separate from card manufacturing. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/mpc-fulfillment-services.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC describes submitting a fulfillment spreadsheet or splitting shipments at checkout and returning tracking numbers in an Excel sheet. Those documented workflows alone do not demonstrate an order API integration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/mpc-fulfillment-services.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC says order changes and cancellation are unavailable after submission; its quality policy asks buyers to report issues within 3 days of receipt and limits personalized-product returns to defects or manufacturing errors. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/guarantee.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] DriveThruCards describes its POD output as a finished physical card product made for an order, with ink-based printing and low-gloss UV coating. Its retail-like look-and-feel statements are manufacturer claims, not an independent shuffle or durability test. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-07-03) — https://help.drivethrucards.com/hc/en-us/articles/12775347188759-Common-Card-Order-Questions-Answers · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] DriveThruCards says most card products ship with cellophane bands, while only some include custom tuck boxes; rules may be a downloadable PDF or cards in the deck. Packaging and printed rules must therefore be checked for the chosen product. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-07-03) — https://help.drivethrucards.com/hc/en-us/articles/12775347188759-Common-Card-Order-Questions-Answers · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] Looney Labs reports using The Game Crafter for loose promotional cards, small packs and Custom Loonacy. This is a publisher report of actual POD use, without measured production throughput or quality statistics. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://faq.looneylabs.com/non-gameplay-questions/game-materials-faq · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] Looney Labs reports that replacement or expansion cards can differ slightly in size, corner radius, thickness, coating or stock despite matching efforts; it also notes that wear makes new cards noticeable in used decks. This operator experience limits assumptions of seamless additions to existing decks. (low confidence) — https://faq.looneylabs.com/non-gameplay-questions/game-materials-faq · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] The Game Crafter recommends buying and checking one physical copy before ordering multiple copies or publishing. - [statement] MPC MarketPlace’s FAQ says commission status changes from pending to locked after approximately 15-40 days if there are no cancellations, making it eligible for payment and the next payment round. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/marketplace/faq-marketplace.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC MarketPlace’s FAQ states a $100.00 accumulated-royalty payment threshold assessed by the first of each month, with below-threshold royalties carried over to the next month’s earnings. It states that sales commissions are paid only in US Dollars. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/marketplace/faq-marketplace.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment
- [statement] MPC’s Shipping page says shipments to US addresses have no import-tax or customs-duty issues. Its fulfillment policy separately says MPC will not pay or compensate sales taxes, import duty, VAT or other customs or postal charges, and assigns these to the service user. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.makeplayingcards.com/shipping.aspx · keywords: Print-on-demand game manufacturing and fulfillment · also: https://www.makeplayingcards.com/mpc-fulfillment-services.aspx
